blurb: Agawam Hunt is a private sporting club on 130 wooded, riverside acres in Rumford, RI. It offers golf, racquets sports including tennis, squash, and pickleball, and summer camps for children. The club has a long history dating back to 1897 and provides facilities including a golf course, racquets courts, and a pool.
